Legume

Jacob's Cattle Bean

About This Entry

Jacob's cattle beans are a New England heirloom with a striking maroon-and-white speckled skin and a rich, slightly sweet flavor well suited to baked-bean dishes — that richness pairs with Pinot Noir.
